ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Sunshine, Victoria**, here are a few well-reviewed options:

- Kolliou Locksmiths – Based in Sunshine, they install digital locks, keypads, deadlocks, and other residential and commercial security systems. [kollioulocksmiths.com.au](https://kollioulocksmiths.com.au/contact-us/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Aus Lock & Safe Company – Located in Sunshine West, offering 24/7 locksmith services including smart lock installation.
- SMART LOCK INSTALLATION – Melbourne-wide specialist focused on smart locks, with experience installing brands such as Yale, Lockwood, Philips, Aqara, Samsung, Schlage, Eufy, and more. [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Typical installation costs in Melbourne are approximately:
- Straightforward replacement (existing compatible lock): **A$150–A$250**
- New smart lock requiring door modifications: **A$250–A$450+**
- Emergency or after-hours service: usually incurs additional call-out charges. [www.reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/AusRenovation/comments/1k6kchh?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Before booking, it's worth checking:
- The **brand and model** of your smart lock.
- Whether your door is **timber, metal, or security screen**.
- If the installer will **set up the app, fingerprint, PIN codes, and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connection** as part of the service.

If you already have a smart lock (for example Yale, Aqara, Lockwood, Samsung, Eufy, or Schlage), let me know the model and I can help estimate the installation cost and confirm whether it's compatible with your door.
